warnings: Heights are printed from ระดับพื้นห้อง. Doors print two widths — the outer (frame) width is width_m, the inner one is leaf_width_m. Window น1 prints 2.00 overall with three 0.60 leaves; window น2 prints 0.70 / 0.60.

Windows: height_m is the window height (น1 1.10, น2 0.45); sill_height_m is the printed distance from ระดับพื้นห้อง to the sill (น1 0.85, น2 1.60) and head_height_m the printed top (น1 2.05, น2 2.15).
count is the printed จำนวน, kept as printed; not cross-checked against the opening tags on the A-03 plan (op04 scope).
